name: Lee 2024 SB12/eculizumab scenarios
description: Separate table provenance and fixed-effect scenarios; no population-prediction claim.

scenarios.name: Exact article and SI source table replay
scenarios.description: No-dose replay exposing Article Tables 3-5, Supplement Tables A1-A2, cohort/dosing counts, and discussion threshold values.
scientific_questions: How does exposure relate to terminal complement inhibition under this fixed-effect regimen?
interpretation_guardrails: No original population fit or individual clinical predictions.
PNH infusion duration is unavailable: conditional bolus simulations cannot qualify Cmax.
Healthy-volunteer LDH is outside the patient-only efficacy relation.
Static source anchors are archival observations, not independent numerical simulation validation.
